### 💡 Codex Review https://github.com/ZZZZihan/anxin-work-rights/blob/4330d5f33367f7f27b3ae5106ee20ab81cd76205/lib/material-fact-source-review.ts#L63-L64 **![P1 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P1-orange?style=flat) Restrict qualifiers to the anchored source event** This collects every clause from every preceding and following block, and nearly all prose that is not recognized by the narrow `separateEvent` patterns becomes a qualifier. Downstream, any nonempty `context.qualifiers` produces `source_relation_unresolved`; I reproduced this by adding an unrelated `天气晴朗。` block to an otherwise valid complete wage total, which made the total ineligible for suggestions. Limit qualifiers to clauses that can actually govern the anchored event rather than allowing arbitrary headers, footnotes, or unrelated paragraphs to invalidate it. --- https://github.com/ZZZZihan/anxin-work-rights/blob/4330d5f33367f7f27b3ae5106ee20ab81cd76205/lib/material-fact-event-review.ts#L135-L138 **![P2 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P2-yellow?style=flat) Support explicitly postposed total beneficiaries** This requires both the worker and period to occur before the amount, so a single-clause statement such as `2026年1月全部应付工资合计4000元应归王甲所有` receives `source_relation_unresolved` even though it explicitly identifies the beneficiary and complete wage period. Because reviewed complete totals with an issue cannot populate the due-field suggestion, support a bounded postposed-owner layout instead of rejecting every owner that follows the value. --- https://github.com/ZZZZihan/anxin-work-rights/blob/4330d5f33367f7f27b3ae5106ee20ab81cd76205/lib/material-fact-event-review.ts#L13-L14 **![P2 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P2-yellow?style=flat) Validate calendar components before accepting date roles** The calendar grammar limits only component length, not actual month/day values or civil-date validity. As a result, runtime validation accepts `2026年0月`, `2026年13月`, `2026年2月30日`, `2026年99月99日`, and `2026-13-40` as supported employment dates with no review issue when followed by `入职`. Parse and validate the captured calendar components—including Chinese numerals and interval ordering—before treating a date as a supported source event.

### 💡 Codex Review https://github.com/ZZZZihan/anxin-work-rights/blob/1cc56d6bc52b67f5c53e7805a9bac0614dfaecd1/lib/material-fact-event-review.ts#L15 **![P2 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P2-yellow?style=flat) Accept grammatical wage-period suffixes** Explicit wage periods written as `2026年1月份` or `2026年度` cannot satisfy this calendar grammar. For example, a `wage_period` candidate in `王甲2026年1月份工资所属期间` receives `source_relation_unresolved`, while the equivalent `2026年1月` form passes; cropping the value to `2026年1月` does not help because the leftover `份` also prevents the surrounding date-role grammar from matching. Accept the bounded `月份` and `年度` spellings for wage-period dates without treating arbitrary text after `月` or `年` as part of a calendar.

### 💡 Codex Review https://github.com/ZZZZihan/anxin-work-rights/blob/b0a9554d0b7ab1a064ce490cee181d2197c31b0c/lib/material-fact-event-review.ts#L171-L172 **![P2 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P2-yellow?style=flat) Accept explicit award beneficiaries after the decision clause** The v4 extraction contract assigns court-ordered wage payments to `meaning: "award"` with the worker as subject, but common layouts such as `法院判决甲公司支付王甲工资4000元` always fail this heading check because the decision and payer precede `王甲`. Runtime review therefore adds `source_relation_unresolved` to an otherwise explicit award; add a bounded decision/payer-to-beneficiary layout rather than requiring every award beneficiary to begin the clause.

### 💡 Codex Review https://github.com/ZZZZihan/anxin-work-rights/blob/6d081321b24b9fadd0088d6cc5b6c60e985eda26/lib/material-fact-event-review.ts#L73-L75 **![P2 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P2-yellow?style=flat) Accept contract dates that name the counterparty** A standard clause such as `王甲于2026年1月1日与甲公司签订劳动合同` returns false from `hasSupportedCandidateAttribution` for a `contract_signing` candidate, while the less informative form without `与甲公司` passes. `dateSide` permits `与` only after it has already consumed a date-role cue and has no bounded counterparty bridge, so naming the employer before or after the date produces `source_relation_unresolved`; accept a finite counterparty segment attached to the contract-signing cue while retaining the worker as the candidate subject.
